page.running_head: SECT. I. PART. I. CAP. XXVI.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~60 letters]causas determinatas: Unde tempori non adscribun-tur: corruptiones vero saepissimè sunt à causis indeterminatis & in specie ignotis: ideoq[?]e tempori tribuuntur.
In tempore deniq; considerandæ partes & partium terminus.
Partes temporis duæ sunt: Præteritum & futurum.
Præteritum est pars temporis quæ fuit & amplius non est: cujus duæ quasi differen-tiæ sunt duobus expressæ adverbiis, Nuper & olim.[illegible, ~40 letters]
Nuper est ea præteriti pars, quæ instans momentum proximè præcessit.
Olim est ea præteriti pars, quæ instans momentum longe antecessit.
Futurum est temporis pars, quæ erit, & nondum est: cujus duæ quoq; differentiæ seu gradus: Repente & Aliquando.
Repente est ea futuri pars quæ instans mo-mentum

page.notes: The left margin column is cropped at the page edge; only fragments are visible and they cannot be read reliably, so the margin notes are marked illegible and their letter counts are estimates. The printed "ideoqae" uses a ligature that is uncertain, marked [?]. The page number and signature number are read from a small scan and may be imperfect. The bottom "men-" is a catchword because it stands alone at the lower right, beside the signature line.
